subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

The summer was _____ hot this year.
solution:
The correct answer is '**too**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**too**" means to a higher degree than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively. (अत्यधिक)
 
• In the sentence, "too hot" indicates that the heat was excessive or more than usual.
 
• The other options: "tow," "two," and "to" do not fit the context as appropriately.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The summer was too__ hot this year.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Tow (खींचना)**: means to pull along with a rope or chain.
 
• **Two (दो)**: refers to the number 2.
 
• **To (की और से, तक)**: is a preposition used to indicate the direction towards a place, person, or position.
